about_the_game:
🖼️ Hentai Summer Swap 2 – Digital Artbook

Take a sensual stroll through summer once more with this exclusive digital artbook from Hentai Summer Swap 2.

Packed with high-quality illustrations and brand-new artwork, this deluxe PDF is your backstage pass to the sun, sweat, and waifus that made your puzzle sessions unforgettable.

📚 What’s inside:

🌴 Clean, high-resolution versions of in-game CGs — no UI, no distractions

🎨 15 all-new, never-before-seen pieces created just for this edition

Whether you're here for the art, the characters, or the beach vibes, this collection is the perfect way to revisit the world of Hentai Summer Swap 2 — one sizzling image at a time.

💡 After purchase, the artbook will be placed in your game’s installation folder under /ArtbookDLC.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains stylized nudity and explicit sexual scenes in unlocked artworks. All characters are adults.
